title: 1844: Hungarian Becomes the Language of State
grammar: Statutory and historical nominalization chains in constitutional prose
goal: I can tell what Széchenyi pledged in 1825 and what Act II of 1844 decided about Hungarian.
I can use -ás/-és nouns with -val/-vel and -ra/-re (elfogadásával, megalapítására) in a short history summary.
I can talk about the Diet, the Learned Society and the language law of 1844.
